title: Mors Drink Delivery
description: Mors Drink Delivery — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Grasshopper the Decembrist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section off Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find Grasshopper and give him this drink of Mors.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Grasshopper the Decembrist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section off Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Find Grasshopper and give him this drink of Mors.

Offer:

When I look at my gifted hands, all covered in this Shadow Spice, I can't help but to wonder about other great artisans like B'Etie Crocher, Chef Byorar'd, Hamburg Elper, and Oscher Maiyor. Is this how they started?

I'd like for you to do one more drink run for me, if you could find it in your heart to help me out.

On the seventh level, you will find the entrance to The Whisker's Library - Dogma Section. Somewhere on that level, you will find Grasshopper, who ordered this drink of Mors. Bring it to him and then all my orders will have been completed.

Turn-in:

Never assume because a man has no eyes he cannot see. Close your eyes. What do you hear?

Do you hear the grasshopper that is at your feet?

Well, you should. I'm talking to you right now. Got you! You gullible fool. Haha, I played a joke at your expense.

Sorry, I must amuse myself. Just looking at you wasn't enough. Now, if you can snatch these coins from my hand, they will be yours to keep.

Oh, and thank you, strange gullible one, for the tasty beverage.

Objectives:

  • Mors Drink ×1

Level range: 75–100
